answer: Before an agent may bid on survey work, the FAA registry check binds one registration number to one Remote ID broadcast serial and one Part 107 certificate, so a second seat reusing that serial is refused at intake. A duplicate serial in the broadcast feed trips a registration revocation, a civil penalty and a call on the operator bond. A module costs 300, registration 5, the exam 175 and an airframe 1200, so N fakes cost N x 1680 plus N logged flight hours. A basalt outcrop painted on the tail, a zephyr charm in the hangar and a voyage plan on the desk change nothing in that registry.
